notes.title: Neckbeards: Fifth Anniversary version 2.0 is out!
notes.content:
It's been a while so an update is long overdue.

Here's what version 2.0 brings to the table:
- Enhanced presentation and usability fixes
- Fixes for a number of in-game cosmetic issues
- Better gamepad-support
- Gave Grotesque a new weapon: say hello to the mighty NEET gun!

Stay superior.

p.s. This update is dedicated to the memory of Tabitha Wood (2025 AD-2938 BC)

notes.title: Neckbeards: Fifth Anniversary Update
notes.content:
Neckbeards: Basement Arena has reached five years on Steam. To celebrate, Soiree Games is proud to release Neckbeards: Fifth Anniversary Edition Update.

- Enjoy the original's 100 levels in their most superior form
- New bonuses, foes, and gameplay adjustments including branching levels and two new characters.. say hello to Womanizer Bob and Mills Wood!
- Equip your champions with eight exciting BATTLEKITS, including the mighty FEDORA KIT DELUXE with its permanent triple fire
- Twin stick controls
- A refreshed hard-hitting soundtrack by Blackbella
- Use teleports to visit the later, absurdly difficult levels

Note: as of January 2023 we have dropped support for the Linux version of the game.

notes.title: Neckbeards - The Superior Update (version 2.0) Out Now!
notes.content:
It's been a while, but this is a big one. With this update, you get..

[list]
    [*]Bigger, better visuals and enhanced sound effects
    [*]Leveling up. Yes, you now gain movement speed and firepower in-game
    [*]A new champion. Say hi to Grotesque the Basement Dweller!
    [*]Analog stick support
[/list]

And much more. Enjoy!

notes.title: Version 1.11 released!
notes.content:
This is both a functional and cosmetic update designed to make Neckbeards a more enjoyable one player experience.
[list]
[*]George, Philip, and Theresa get an 8% boost in firepower when playing a single player game
[*] The Supreme Gentleman gets a 10% boost in firepower when playing solo
[*] Generators now spawn enemies at a slower rate
[*] Fixed a bug of player two not being able to damage some enemies
[*] The two player debriefing screen now has visual representations for both players[/list]

Tthe game also has some brand new artwork based on one of the most cherished NPCs, Eggman. ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Version 1.1 released!
notes.content:
This is a relatively major update for Neckbeards: Basement Arena. 

Changes to the previous version (1.01) include:

[list]
    [*]Fixed a few potentially game-breaking bugs
    [*]Fixed the issue of players getting stuck on obstacles
    [*]Made [i]The Supreme Gentleman[/i] slightly more powerful
    [*]Made several enemies unable to walk through obstacles
    [*]Added an Eggman-bonus to the [i]Troll King[/i] -basement (level 10)  to make it a more balanced challenge
[/list]

In addition, the game now has a hipper, more chic title screen. Enjoy!
